title: Add cross-layer variable references: {layer.N.V} and {requires.N.V}
description: Extend the new-paradigm variable interpolation to support two new reference forms in layer var values: (1) {layer.layername.varname} references a variable in any named prior layer in the stack; (2) {requires.requirename.varname} references a variable in the layer that provides a named requirement. Requires updating generate_instances in graph.py and adding tests.
close_reason: Implemented in graph.py (_expand_cross_layer_refs + generate_instances tracking) and util.py (AttributeError catch), 16 new tests in test_cross_layer_refs.py
